As I walk along this scenic boulevard, I am reminded of the rich history that lies beneath its surface. Originally a narrow dike named Cổ Ngư, this road has been transformed over the centuries, with tens of thousands of young people and students in the capital, undeterred by hardships, using their youthful strength to build and expand the road surface to its present spacious state.
